Xenomorphs are deadly, silent. They lurk in darkness and can appear where you least expect it… Except in this game where hundreds of them just start coming out of the woodwork.

Good and Bad

The good: It's fun. I won't lie, it's fun to shoot things up, swarms of them all coming at you. there’s something satisfying about just shoot lots of things trying to kill you. The classes can be interesting, but they’re not the biggest feature and they aren’t that distinct.  

The Bad: There isn't much of a story and you'll feel hard pressed to really care about it. It's not really the main focus, more a means of explaining why the map has changed. The NPCs speaking can get repetitive fast, talking almost constantly while you’re busy trying to shoot the things they’re talking about. The game enjoys slowing down your progress with tasks designed to extend the game slightly, and not very subtly.

While this game was enjoyable, you can’t help but feel you’re not getting your money’s worth. If you are looking for good Aliens experience with a story and characters you can invest in, look elsewhere. If you’re looking for a short shoot ‘em to play with a couple of friends then this is worth a shot, but even then, I’d advised buying it on discount.

Overall score: 5
